title: Tin's paper #F5F1E6 with fine grain and fibres; grain that moves every frame
use: Ground of every shot. Fixed paper (seeded noise and fibres, ~1.7 levels) plus a zero-mean grain field shifted by a frame-seeded offset every frame (~2.3 levels on paper, ~1.8 levels of change frame to frame).

title: The Tin mark with the n's arches refitted as smooth Beziers
use: scripts/markfit.py: least-squares smoothing spline through the traced polygon's arches (max deviation 0.30 and 0.28 viewBox units); every straight edge kept vertex for vertex.

title: 1996 banner GIF: the mark on a 20 px grid in two web-safe colours, ordered dither, hard shadow
use: scripts/web1996.py banner2 --px 20 --fill checker --shadow: web-safe #FF0000 and #FFCC00 in a Bayer 4x4 pattern (a flat orange the 216-colour palette could not show), one-cell black drop shadow. No source image.

title: Search results page, c. 2004 (generic, example.com domains)
use: Set in Liberation Sans (SIL OFL 1.1, Arial's metrics; src/fonts/) at 2.2x a 2004 page, inside the mark, on Tin's deep paper (paper-deep from DESIGN.md). No real engine, brand or site.

title: The terminal: an agent's marketing log on terminal blue #90D7E4
use: SF Mono (refs/brand/fonts) at 46 px, ink at 0.86; the log scrolls one line per beat; the drain floods the mark with ink from the top over one beat.

title: End card: mark, hairline grid, tin.computer, lime cursor
use: Funktional Grotesk Medium; 9% ink grid aligned to the mark's cap line and baseline; lime-cta block cursor, the only lime in the film.
